title: Find the Original Typed String II
sources: https://leetcode.com/problems/find-the-original-typed-string-ii/ (official page returns 403 to fetch; link from web search)
accessAttempt: Constraints and three examples from the doocs mirror (the third example lacks an explanation on the mirror; its output 8 was checked by hand).
summary: Count possible original strings (any number of over-held keys) of length at least k for the typed word, modulo 1e9+7.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps word length and k at 40 (the DP table is runs by sums); official limits are larger.
